mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower unemployment signals labor market strength and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-positive 20d returns despite UNRATE crossing below 4.5% within the next month (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: When supply-side growth (INDPRO) outpaces demand-side growth (GDPC1), S&P 500 forward returns are positively influenced over the next 20 trading days due to expanded production capacity and reduced supply bottlenecks.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth rate exceeds GDPC1 growth rate
regime_hint: supply-demand imbalance in favor of production
failure_condition: 20d returns are not positive despite INDPRO growth rate consistently exceeding GDPC1 growth rate over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate during a tightening monetary cycle reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are not negative despite FEDFUNDS rising consistently over the next quarter (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in economic demand (GDPC1) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened consumer and business activity.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not positive despite GDPC1 growth persisting over the 5-day horizon (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the supply index (INDPRO) above 112.1 triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as expanded production capacity alleviates supply bottlenecks.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not positive despite INDPRO exceeding 112.1 within the next 5 days (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A dual labor market signal: falling unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) and rising employment (PAYEMS growth) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as confidence in labor market strengthens.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% and PAYEMS growth rate exceeds prior month's
failure_condition: 20d returns are not positive despite both UNRATE and PAYEMS meeting the trigger conditions (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) and sustained demand growth (GDPC1) drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as monetary easing supports equity valuations.
regime_hint: monetary easing cycle with strong demand
failure_condition: 20d returns are not positive despite FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 growth occurring concurrently (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: Positive growth in the supply index (INDPRO) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expanded production capacity and reduced supply constraints.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not positive despite INDPRO growth persisting over the 60-day horizon (p > 0.05 in t-test).
